title: RSL Companion consolidated account export
description: Payload POSTed to {ApiBaseUrl}/api/sync/consolidated/raw. One complete snapshot of one game account; a full replace, not a delta. Self-identifying: the server routes by the in-game accountId it carries. Human-readable contract and changelog: export-schema.md (keep both in sync, same commit).

accountId.description: In-game account id. The routing key; always equals account.accountId.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the snapshot was taken.

uploaderVersion.description: Desktop app build that produced this payload. Stamped by the app, NOT by the extraction engine, so it is absent from engine-level dumps.

gameVersion.description: Live Raid build the snapshot was read from. Null when it could not be determined.

accountId.description: Duplicate of the top-level accountId; always equal.

resources.description: ALWAYS the complete allowlist (49 ids as of schema 3). Ids the account holds none of are present with quantity 0, so a missing id means the allowlist changed - never 'zero owned'. Join on id, NEVER on name: names track in-game renames (three changed in v1.5.4).

id.description: Stable allowlist id. The only safe join key.

name.description: Display label. NOT stable across releases.

x-soulEconomy.description: Corrected in schema 3 / v1.5.4. Ids 10101, 10102, 10104, 10105, 10201 and 10204 are a DEFUNCT earlier soul system: they are not allowlisted, are never emitted, and must not be mapped onto the ids below - doing so is the bug v1.5.4 fixed.

ids.1111: Mortal Soul Coin (was 'Silver Soul Coin'; value was wrong before v1.5.4)
ids.1112: Immortal Soul Coin (was 'Gold Soul Coin'; value was wrong before v1.5.4)
ids.1113: Eternal Soul Coin (was 'Immortal Essence'; value was wrong before v1.5.4)
ids.10205: Eternal Essence (legacy; still emitted, semantics unverified)

name.description: Null when the champion index cannot resolve it.

instanceId.description: int64. Unique per OWNED COPY. Join key for factionGuardians and artifacts.

baseTypeId.description: Champion type, ascension digit stripped. Copies of one champion share this.

factionId.description: 0 when unresolved. Same id space as factionGuardians[].factionId.

blessingChosen.description: A blessing is equipped. Only ever true when awakeningLevel > 0.

isFactionGuardian.description: This copy is placed in an Academy guardian slot.

masteries.description: Always present and fully populated - deliberately verbose so consumers never null-check. Per-node metadata (name/tree/tier/cost) is intentionally absent: it is constant game data, joined from mastery_index.json in the RslCompanionMetadata repo.

selected.description: Chosen mastery node ids; empty array when none, never null. The id encodes position: 500*tree*tier*slot, tier being the tens digit.

totalScrolls.description: Unspent PLUS already spent on selected (each node's activation cost).

factionGuardians.description: Academy guardian slots. Each slot fuses up to TWO copies of one champion, hence the First/Second pair.

heroTypeId.description: Champion type WITH the ascension digit (366 = base 360 at ascension 6). Do NOT join this onto heroes[].baseTypeId.

heroBaseTypeId.description: Ascension stripped. THIS is what joins to heroes[].baseTypeId. The game's own field is misleadingly named HeroBaseTypeId but carries the ascension digit; both forms are published so consumers need not guess.

firstHeroInstanceId.description: Null when that half of the slot is empty.

secondHeroInstanceId.description: Null when that half of the slot is empty.

artifacts.description: EXPECT THIS TO BE EMPTY. Artifact stats moved to Unity ECS component storage and extraction is blocked upstream; the app also skips artifacts unless explicitly enabled. Treat any content as optional/best-effort and never assume non-empty.

scrollBalance.description: Mastery-scroll balance. ALWAYS carries all three rarities, defaulting to 0.
